query:
mutation NetmaskUpdate($netmasks: [NetmaskInput!]!) {
  netmaskUpdate(netmasks: $netmasks) {
    id
    name
    netmask
    forClients
    forServers
    importance
    storeName
    squashAddresses
    zoneIn
    zoneOut
    enabled
    sortOrder
    description
    ignored
    reportingGroup
    __typename
  }
}
